g.text: One audit engine, four SalesDuo surfaces, each through one API endpoint.
“Alexa recommendation visibility is not currently available
as a standalone metric in Seller Central.”
Paste an ASIN. See what a shopping
assistant can say from the listing,
with proof, and the fixes ranked.
Each gap becomes a brief Studio can take:
AI shelf readiness score per ASIN,
Skipped if the content hash is unchanged.
Widget: instant audit, top 3 gaps free,
It doesn't measure Alexa. It measures what Alexa reads: the listing, its images and its reviews.
